description: Land Acquisition - Alawathugoda, Akurana D/S Division, Kandy Distruct - Medawala, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for the acquisition of specific land parcels (Lots A-P and Lots A-B) with exact measurements, boundary descriptions, and location details. The content focuses exclusively on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural reforms, or other administrative categories. The mention of the Minister is purely procedural as required by the Land Acquisition Act for declaring acquisitions, not about government personnel matters.
